integrity: The proof separates the general Fourier altitude lemma from the binary gcd calculation. The bundled checker independently reconstructs the source residual and verifies the closed form on all separations for \(3\le n\le30\). No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the scalar saturated CPT row-ordering proxy with exactly two active binary rows. It does not claim a full alternative power law, and it does not cover nonsaturated cyclic groups, more than two active rows, or nuisance covariates.
title: An arithmetic row-ordering obstruction for sparse-binary cyclic permutation tests
